title: New atrial fibrillation, home; follow-up, pending-result owner, DP evaluation and transmission are all hedged or future tense

rationale.followup: 'Will likely need cardiology follow-up in 2-3 weeks' is a hedge, nothing is scheduled, and the nursing note only says to call 'if palpitations continue'; no committed who-and-when.
rationale.pending_results: The pending TSH is listed, but 'plan to have someone from the team follow up' names no responsible clinician.
rationale.info_transmitted: 'To be faxed ... once signed' is future tense; there is no evidence the summary was actually sent.
rationale.dp_evaluation: The section says the evaluation 'will be completed' by case management; no CM note was provided and no evaluation content is written.
rationale.pcp_named: Dr. Samuel Achterberg is named as PCP even though no PCP visit is scheduled.
rationale.pac_list: Home without services, so the post-acute rules do not apply.
